meta.title: Amin Ceramic
meta.description: Porcelain and ceramic surfaces for Lebanese homes, studios and sites.

foundation.title: Surfaces that hold their line.
foundation.lede: This route exists to prove the foundation, not to sell anything. Every colour, type step, spacing value, radius, shadow and easing curve below is read from a design token. Nothing here is hardcoded.

tenant.heading: Seeded tenant, read live through Prisma
tenant.note: Read through an application use-case, which calls a repository that returns a domain type. No Prisma type reaches this component.
tenant.name: Name
tenant.unavailableNote: Set DATABASE_URL in .env.local, then run pnpm db:migrate and pnpm db:seed.

colour.heading: Brand ramp
colour.note: Contrast ratios are computed from the token values at render time, not transcribed from the design document.
colour.cyanRule: cyan-400 is 2.0:1 on white. It is a surface, stroke, glow and motion colour — never text on a light ground. On navy-700 it reaches 6.2:1 and is permitted.

type.heading: Type scale
type.note: Arabic steps up 8% in size and 12% in line-height, with tracking forced to zero — letter-spacing breaks the cursive joins.

logical.heading: Layout mirrors, brand geometry does not
logical.note: Switch to Arabic: the rail moves to the other side because everything uses logical properties. The diamond keeps its bottom-left to top-right axis, because mirroring it would alter the brand mark.

focus.heading: One focus treatment
focus.note: Tab through these. The same ring appears on every control, on light and dark grounds alike, and is never clipped by an overflow-hidden ancestor.
focus.onDark: On a dark ground the ring becomes cyan-400, which reaches 6.2:1 there.

motion.heading: Motion tokens
motion.note: Nothing bounces — tile is heavy. Exits run about 30% faster than entrances. All of this collapses to nothing under prefers-reduced-motion.
